svg.text: MCP-first data extraction with script fallback | Claude Code Skill
- External attack IP list (filtered by whitelist)
- Attack type distribution (SQL injection / XSS / RCE ...)
- Severity level breakdown (攻击成功 / 失陷)
- Compromised host inventory (横向渗透 detection)
- High-confidence malicious IPs for firewall blocking | Risk scoring (1-10) per IP | Auto-generated iptables/ACL rules
ES Index: logfmt_746_YYYYMMDD (one index per day)
Filter: host_state IN ('攻击成功','失陷') AND sip_addr != '局域网'
Zero npm dependencies · Pure Node.js ESM

g.text: Dashed region boundaries group components by architectural layer
MCP = primary query path; Script Pipeline = automatic fallback on MCP failure
